> Automated ECU & TCU calibration ecosystem for Passenger Cars (4973+ ECUs / 82 brands), 69,187+ verified OEM ECU Software Numbers (Bosch 1037/10SW, Continental, Delphi, Denso, Marelli), Heavy-Duty 24V Trucks & Agriculture (452+ ECUs / 82 brands), Marine Boats / Jet Skis / Yachts (30+ brands + 35 engine models), transparent Software Licenses (€9.99–€1,890), 0-Credit Emissions Deletes, Browser Cloud Tokens (1 Token = €1), B2B Cloud REST API (`/api/v1/cloud/*` + 9 Official SDKs + White-Label `.exe` Brand), 40 Bench GPT/Boot hardware pinout guides, 35 citable glossary definitions, 14 Custom WinOLS motorsport hubs, 35 deep-dive calibration solutions, 50 iconic OEM engine guides, 25 Master programmer workflows, 427 real-world ECU calibration module matrices, 351 Brand×ECU subsystem DTC matrices, 148 OBD2/Euro 6d DTC guides, 25 automatic TCU gearboxes, 300 verified DAMOS/A2L/ORI shop packages, and 361 engineering guides — backed by 24h/7 365-day live multilingual engineering support. Always process 100% virgin original ECU readouts.
